content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on the cap / floor screen, each Save click (ids 325, 374, 423) is followed by a visible error event (app:52, app:66, app:80) about 300 to 500 ms later, and the user edits the Notional field before each retry (ids 350/351, 399/400), which suggests the Save validation fails on an input that is not identified in the error event.", "fix": "Fix: on the cap / floor screen, change the Save button's validation handler so that a failed save shows the error message inline beside the invalid field and moves focus to that field, instead of a generic visible error that does not name the field.", "cited_event_ids": ["325", "app:52", "350", "351", "374", "app:66", "399", "400", "423", "app:80"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["Which field fails validation: the error events carry no label, message, or target field.", "The error message text and whether it names a field.", "Whether the Notional edits are what fixes the error; the events show edits, not a passing validation.", "Only one session window (S26000026) was provided; the other two affected sessions, the 8.6 s to 12 s loop timings, and the median 11 s lost are taken from the insight facts and not verified in events.", "The Trade Date and Counterparty errors (ids 49:a54, 54:a62, 290:a335) occur before Save and are not linked to the Save loops by the events."]}
